%
% File    : lecture_notes.tex
% ____________________________________________________________________________
%
% DESCRIPTION :
%
% Main file for the lecture notes handout. Built on the OxEngThesis class
% from https://github.com/maurovm/thesis_template (tracked as the "upstream"
% git remote).
%
% To keep merges from upstream painless, do NOT edit the upstream files
% (oxengthesis.cls, sample_dphil_thesis.tex, chap_*.tex, titlepage-*.tex, ...).
% Everything specific to these notes lives in this file, in frontmatter/,
% lectures/, figures/generated/ and code/.
% ____________________________________________________________________________
%


% "report" skips the dedication, declaration and publications pages.
% Symmetric margins suit a printed handout better than thesis binding margins.

\documentclass[report, leftmargin=2.5cm, rightmargin=2.5cm]{oxengthesis}


%
% Point the class at our own front matter files instead of the upstream
% sample files in the repository root. A page is only included if its file
% exists, so create e.g. frontmatter/abstract.tex to add an abstract page.
%

\makeatletter
\def\oxfordtitlefilename{frontmatter/titlepage}
\def\abstractfilename{frontmatter/abstract}
\def\acknowledgementsfilename{frontmatter/acknowledgements}
\def\glossaryfilename{frontmatter/glossary}
\def\bibliographyfilename{lectures/references}
\makeatother


%
% Document metadata
%

\title       {Lecture Notes Title}
\author      {Edward Phillips}
\department  {Department of Engineering Science}
\date        {Michaelmas Term, 2026}


%
% Document contents
%

\begin{document}

\frontmatter
\makefrontmatterpages

\mainmatter

\include{lectures/lecture_01}
\include{lectures/lecture_02}

\backmatter
\listofreferences

\end{document}
